# multirobot_interfaces

Shared ROS 2 messages and services for the UCAB multi-robot track (Phineas, Ferb, and Perry).

- **Source repository:** https://github.com/alejandrovielma/ucab-multirobot
- **Reference commit:** `09d0f16` (2026-10-23)

**Do not edit, update from upstream.** DDS type matching requires byte-identical `.msg`, `.srv`, `CMakeLists.txt`, and `package.xml` files across all robots.
